2026-08-18.summary:
### NPC & AI Fixes
- Fixed scientists not spawning in Underwater Labs, Cargo Ships, and Military Base.  
- Fixed cargo scientists now move correctly instead of staying still.  
- Fixed NPCs getting stuck when a navmesh tile rebuilds while they are inside or crossing it.  
- Fixed Scientist 2 on the Oilrig crouch‑walking upstairs at an odd angle.  
- Fixed old scientists steering incorrectly – they now turn instantly.

### Vehicles
- Fixed several vehicle‑pooling bugs: catapult loaded ammo now works, horses persist correctly, siege weapons reset properly after use, and helicopter rotor speed is reset on init to prevent lingering spin.

### Weapons
- Fixed weapon visual and animation issues: flamethrower flame now aligns with the muzzle, salvaged hammer third‑person model offset corrected, and machete swing animation updated for smoother attacks.

### Items & Consumables
- Fixed honey bandage effects now trigger as intended.  
- Fixed the colour picker to accept pasted hex‑code inputs.

### World & Monuments
- Fixed static chairs on the gas‑station roof now mountable.  
- Adjusted monument blocker resource rates and melee time‑to‑kill for consistent behavior.  
- Fixed monument toggle switches error.

### UI
- Fixed tutorial modal size, added localization, and cleaned up the connection modal description.
2026-08-18.new_summary:
- NPCs no longer get stuck when the navigation mesh updates while they’re inside or crossing a tile.  
- Monument toggle switches work correctly again, fixing previous activation errors.  
- Vehicle behavior is more reliable, and flag collisions (including the ridable horse flag) have been resolved.  
- The flamethrower’s third‑person flame now appears in the correct position.  
- Painting menus keep their own colors, the colour picker accepts pasted hex codes, and pumpkin carving visuals (no double projections, proper alpha, and no colour picker) have been fixed.

2026-08-17.summary:
### Animals
- Fixed the gender bug: livestock now spawn with the correct male/female distribution instead of all being female.  
- Added a breeding state machine, enabling animals to breed as intended.  
- Introduced a Bull prefab, so bulls now appear in the world.

### Server & UI
- Nexus connect modal now correctly enables the map button and no longer squishes the map view.  
- Nexus map UI issues resolved, preventing the map from being distorted after recent changes.  
- Server listings now hide zone servers by default and expose Nexus info in A2S rules responses.  
- MaxPlayers count displayed correctly after recent adjustments.  
- General Nexus connect modal fixes improve stability when joining servers.

### Items & Equipment
- Medical honey bandage effects now fire properly, restoring the intended healing behavior.  
- Water bucket UI bug fixed: players can now transfer water into a held bucket without errors.

### Vehicles
- Resolved a pooling issue where runtime‑parented vehicle children caused null‑reference errors, improving vehicle spawn stability.
